changes: 新增 core/dirty-worktree.ts 统一解析和分类 git dirty rows；DONE git-working-tree row 和 validation-executor worktree pollution details 现在按 koala_metadata_changes、runtime_artifact_changes、material_source_changes、fixture_changes、unexpected_dirty_files 分组展示；补充 flow-stability 与 validation-protocol smoke 覆盖分类和不放松阻塞策略。
usage: 用户继续照常运行 koala validate、koala session_brief 或 story_advance DONE；当 dirty worktree 出现时，提示会按 ownership 分类列出原始路径，unexpected_dirty_files 仍需提交、移除或后续声明后才能通过。
expectedOutcome: 用户在 TEST/DONE gate 或 koala validate side-effect guard 遇到 dirty worktree 时，终端看到类似 `4 dirty path(s): ... unexpected_dirty_files=1`，并看到按 `koala_metadata_changes`、`runtime_artifact_changes`、`unexpected_dirty_files` 分组的路径。
actualTranscript: `npm --prefix packages/main run test:flow-stability-smoke` 输出 `✓ flow stability smoke passed`; `npm --prefix packages/main run test:validation-protocol` 输出 `✓ validation protocol smoke passed`; `npm --prefix packages/main run test:verification-freshness-smoke` 输出 `✓ verification freshness smoke passed`; `koala validate --story=B-6326 --json` 返回 `status: pass`, `allPass: true`, `Verification intent coverage: 18/18 covered`. 多类别 smoke 断言包含 `koala_metadata_changes`, `runtime_artifact_changes`, `fixture_changes`, `unexpected_dirty_files` 和 BL21 lacZ viewer path。
outcomeDiff: 实际输出符合预期；本 story 只改进分类和提示，不尝试自动放行 Koala metadata 或声明 generated artifact。
limitations: No generated artifact allowlist and no Koala metadata auto-commit policy in this story; BL21 lacZ viewer output remains unexpected_dirty_files until B-cf60 implements declaration support.
pitfalls: Merging main after REVIEW made existing verificationEvidence stale, so the correct recovery path was to rerun focused smoke, run verification_evidence_refresh_stale, then rerun koala validate.
